stem:
Victor bought 36 eggs at a grocery store. The eggs were in cartons with 12 eggs in each carton.

Which model best represents the number of cartons of eggs Victor bought?

options.label: A
options.text: One carton with 12 eggs shown partially crossed out

options.label: C
options.text: Two cartons with 12 eggs and one larger carton with 24 eggs

options.label: D
options.text: Three small cartons with 6 eggs each

visual_elements: image of cartons of eggs labeled A, B, C, D with different quantities and arrangements of eggs to represent the models
difficulty_rationale: The question requires a simple division calculation (36 eggs ÷ 12 eggs per carton) to identify the correct model representing the number of cartons; this involves straightforward reasoning with visible cues.
